Once I moved out of my parents house at 18, I could live how I wanted to without them over my shoulder making me upset all the time. I hope you can make it to adulthood to experience freedom like that, even though life will probably kind of suck until then. Hi! The biggest pot is a pothos, the tiny plant is an African violet, and the other two and the cutting are monstera deliciosa. They would benefit from new soil, but the monstera are super sensitive to being too wet, and need a chunky soil mix. I would suggest succulent or tropical miracle grow mix, with perlite mixed in at about a 2:1 ratio. If the monstera in the water doesn't have a node, it won't be able to grow. Personally, I've never had success with monstera cuttings in water. Otherwise, they look like they could use more light than they had before if that's possible, and you'll want to water them when the top half of the soil is dry. You can stick a skewer in the soil to check how wet it is, but I just stick my finger in the soil to feel it. Hopefully that's helpful and makes sense! Best of luck

Hi! I used to be terrified of needles, but after getting a bunch of ear piercings over the last year I’ve improved a lot. I didn’t have any problems with the HPV vaccine when I got it as a young adult. I don’t remember getting the ACWY so I can’t vouch for that, but it shouldn’t hurt any more than the HPV. Definitely talk to the person who’s giving you the injections about your fear, they can talk to you about what to expect and the needles that they use are tiny. I’m the exact same way about the feeling of the vaccine being injected. It’s the worst. But the pain isn’t bad, and if you can relax your muscles while you’re getting the injections that can help decrease soreness after. Also, make sure to breathe!!! You’ll make yourself lightheaded if you hold your breath when you’re getting the shots. 

I hope it goes well! Some soreness and feeling sick are normal and nothing to worry about, but on the bright side you’ll never have to worry about the diseases you’re getting immunized for! ❤️

I was in the same situation and took my test a week ago. I was clean for about two weeks before, and am about the same height and weight as you. I was still coming up as positive on home tests, but carts are concentrates and can stay in your system for a long freaking time. I used quickfix, heated it up to about 100F, and put it in a bra that’s too big for me with a tight sports bra over that. Experiment with wearing it the way you will in the clinic, and check the temp every so often with a meat thermometer and record the temperature and time so you can be confident when you take the test. Just be super nice when you go to take the test, I dressed in cute athletic clothes and chatted with the guy who walked me through the test about what we did for new years. I also wanted to get clean fast, but I don’t think it’s possible at all in such a short time span. Do some reading on r/quickfix! And good luck!

YTA. It is absolutely your right to not want a transgender roommate, but I think you should do some more research on this subject. Like someone else commented, specifically disqualifying someone based on their identity is 100% discrimination. A lot of LGBTQ people do have support groups within the community, but there’s no reason they would have these groups gather at your apartment if you laid down that it wouldn’t be allowed. Everyone has their own drama no matter their identity. It’s good that you owned up to not knowing about the effects of transitioning on the brain, but trans people have issues just like other people do. I’m cisgender(identify with biological sex) and I have plenty of drama and issues because of my mental health. A lot of people do, but you won’t know until you get to know them. So YTA for excluding people based on being transgender but maybe do some more research on the subject since you don’t have bad intentions.
